item.text:
Implemented [run.sh](/work/run.sh) using AssemblyAI’s British English locale (`en_uk`).

Tested successfully with `sample.wav`: output includes “organise”, “colour”, “centre”, and “catalogued”.

Run:
```sh
./run.sh <audio.wav> <out.json>
```

Writes the required JSON, exits 0 on success, and non-zero on failure. No additional packages needed.
